page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top centre and page number at the top left. No marginal notes. Citations are set at the end of paragraphs in italic.

main_text.l: XXXV.
Christianis, fidē[?] non ficta pias mentes mun-
dantibus, tanquam temerè credulis insultatis. lib. 20. cap. 9.
XXXVI.
Isti, ea quæ non intelligunt reprehendentes,
similes sunt hominibus quibus displicent ea
quorum non capiunt utilitatem: velut si sur-
dus videns moveri labia loquentium, tanquā
superfluos oris motus deformesque reprehenderet:
vel si quisquam cæcus laudata sibi ali-
qua domo, vellet palpando probare quod di-
citur, & parietum levitatem manu pertra-
ctans, in fenestras irrueret, easque velut incon-
venientes illi æqualitati redarguere[?]t, cavernas-
que ruinosas putaret. lib. 22. cap. 7.
XXXVII.
Legunt Scripturas apocryphas, à nescio qui-
bus sutoribus fabularum, sub †[?] postolorum
nomine scriptas: quæ suorum scriptorum tem-
poribus in authoritatem sanctæ Ecclesiæ recipi
merentur, si sancti & docti homines, qui tunc
in vita erant, & examinare talia poterant, eos
vera locutos esse cognoscerent. Eod.lib.cap.69.
XXXVIII.
Videtis id vos agere, ut omnis de medio Scri-
pturarū auferatur authoritas, & suus cuiq; ani-
mus author fit, quid in quaq; Scriptura probet,
quid improbet: id est, ut non authoritati Scri-
pturarum subiiciatur ad fidem, sed sibi Scri-
pturas ipse subiiciat: non ut ideo illi placcat[?]
aliquid,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "fidē" in the first line is hard to make out. "redarguerēt" has an unclear final letter. The sign before "postolorum" is an unclear symbol, perhaps a dagger, and the word looks like "apostolorum" with its "a" missing or replaced. "placcat" may be a printing error for "placeat". The running head is set in small capitals with a ligature in "IESVITIC". The paragraph in XXXVIII continues on the next page.
